- **Archive parent:** Gray Speck
- **Builder:** Chicago Stompworks
- **Catalog type:** Overdrive / Distortion
- **Identity:** Point-to-point recreation of the 1979 gray-spec DOD OD250 using an LM741 op-amp and 1N4148 clipping diodes. [1][2]

- **Primary reference:** DOD **OD250 1979 Gray Spec**.
- Chicago Stompworks builds the pedal as a close recreation of that circuit. [1][2]

- **LM741 op-amp**. [2]

- **1N4148** clipping diodes. [2]

- Minimal OD250-style control interface.
- Exact printed control-label layout is not reconstructed where the reviewed sources do not preserve it.

- **Point-to-point wiring**
- **1590B** enclosure.
- **True bypass**
- Internal battery support. [1][2]

- **9V center-negative** external supply or internal battery. [1]

- No numbered Chicago Stompworks electronic revision established.
- Silver/sparkle, barebox and knob/LED changes are treated as cosmetic production variations.

Gray Speck targets the direct, hard-edged OD250 response that can function as either a compact boost or overdrive. The archive does not add a broader “DOD 250 family” claim beyond the documented 1979 gray-spec reference. [1][2]

- **Identity:** High
- **1979 Gray Spec lineage:** High
- **LM741:** High
- **1N4148:** High
- **Point-to-point / 1590B:** High
- **Exact control labels:** Medium

Chicago Stompworks' product catalog was cross-checked with the Effects Database exact-model record. The combined evidence supports the 1979 Gray Spec lineage and the component-level LM741/1N4148 implementation. [1][2]

1. Chicago Stompworks — Gray Speck: https://www.chicagostompworks.com/
2. Effects Database — Chicago Stompworks Gray Speck: https://www.effectsdatabase.com/model/chicagostompworks/grayspeck

Home Home HANDBUILT PEDALS MICRO PEDALS BARE BOX DEALS ACCESSORIES Mr. Vermin - Original RAT clone $64.99 Our “Desert island” pedal. You need just one pedal to cover every “rock” tone? It's Mister Vermin. Built on the original specs his rodent ancestors, Mister Vermin delivers endless amounts of creamy, crunchy amp stack tone. Desirable version 2, down to the clockwise filter control (the filter cuts high frequencies as it is turned clockwise). Once again shipping with current Chinese LM308N chip installed - chip is socketed for easy swapping of many other compatible opamp chips (OP07, LM741, TL071, TL081, NE5534, CA3130 etc.) - genuine N.O.S. Motorola 2n5458 JFET output transistor installed. -1590b sized enclosure (4.409" x 2.382" x1 .220") -handbuilt boutique quality throughout -true bypass, hand wired with high quality open frame jacks -"best in class" hand soldered, through-hole components -standard center negative "Boss style" 9v jack or internal battery - current draw 2ma This pedal covers almost every hard rock guitar tone you'll ever need, period! Shop LEGITIMATE BEEF boost pedal $59.99 LEGITIMATE BEEF: The Chicago Stompworks recreation of the original Red Llama pedal - huge db output, warm crunch... this is THE solution for a tube amp front end. CD4049 chip, big 330uf cap - incredible amount of volume output from this pedal, and a super warm rumbly overdrive that doesn't thin out or lose ANY bottom end. Your tube front end wants to be driven by this pedal!
